# pi-herdr-clean-craft

This prerelease is a metadata-only bootstrap. The project's GitHub Actions workflow publishes it through npm trusted publishing, with a provenance statement, to check that publication path before any skills release uses it.

It is not a usable Pi skills package. It contains only package metadata, this README, and the MIT license. It has no skills, no Pi package registration, no executable code, no dependencies, and no installation scripts. Installing it gives you nothing to run.

The skills pack is still under development, and its required integration and release checks have not passed. This version does not establish compatibility or release readiness, and it does not waive any release check.

It is published under the `bootstrap` dist-tag. Do not use it in place of the finished skills pack.

Project repository: https://github.com/giuseppecrj/pi-herdr-clean-craft
